title: Automations
description: Simple rules that notify, add Today items, or prepare drafts. They never post money or approve on their own.

quote_no_followup.name: Quote without follow-up
quote_no_followup.hint: When a quote has had no follow-up for the set number of days.

vendor_bill_due.name: Vendor bill due
vendor_bill_due.hint: When a supplier bill reaches its due date.

timesheet_not_submitted.name: Timesheet not submitted
timesheet_not_submitted.hint: When a timesheet is still missing.

timesheet_waiting_approval.name: Timesheet waiting for approval
timesheet_waiting_approval.hint: When a timesheet is waiting for approval.

ocr_waiting_review.name: Invoice capture waiting for review
ocr_waiting_review.hint: When a scanned invoice is waiting for review.

forecast_over_budget.name: Forecast over budget

forecast_margin_low.name: Forecast margin low
forecast_margin_low.hint: When forecast margin drops below the threshold.

warranty_expiring.name: Warranty approaching expiry
warranty_expiring.hint: When warranty coverage is near its end date.

compliance_expiring.name: Compliance document expiring
compliance_expiring.hint: When a license or insurance is near expiry.

asset_service_due.name: Equipment service due

task_overdue.hint: When a task is past its due date.

task_assigned_to.name: Task assigned
task_assigned_to.hint: When a task is assigned to a team member.

task_created_from_template.name: Task created from a template
task_created_from_template.hint: When a task is created from a template.

task_approval_rejected.name: Task approval rejected
task_approval_rejected.hint: When a task approval request is rejected.

task_dependency_resolved.name: Task dependency resolved
task_dependency_resolved.hint: When a dependency blocking a task is resolved.

milestone_approaching_days.name: Milestone approaching
milestone_approaching_days.hint: When a project milestone falls within the next few days.

project_created.name: Project created
project_created.hint: When a new project is created.

unavailable: Unavailable. This rule needs an event that ProjectFlow does not record, so it cannot run.
safeNote: Rules may notify, add a Today item, create a follow-up task, or prepare a draft. They cannot post, pay, approve, or change contracts.

notAllowed.title: Automations are not available
notAllowed.body: You do not have permission to view automations.

errors.unsafeAction: This rule cannot post, pay, approve, or change contracts.

empty.title: No rules yet
empty.body: Turn on a preset. You can change the thresholds later.
